text_check.text_sample: FirePit BBQ Co. - Authentic Charcoal BBQ, Lahore. Mixed grill platters, chicken tikka, seekh kebab, BBQ wraps and burgers. Order for delivery or pickup. Call +92 42 1234567. Based in Lahore, Pakistan.

notes: No JSON-LD structured data found at all. AI answer engines and search engines have to fall back to guessing from plain text, which is far less reliable than an explicit schema.org declaration.

No business-identity schema type found (e.g. Restaurant or FoodEstablishment). This is usually the single highest-value fix -- it tells answer engines what kind of business this is, where it is, and how to contact it, in a format they can parse directly.

No Review/AggregateRating markup found. Even if the business has real reviews elsewhere (Google, Facebook), without Review/AggregateRating schema on the site itself, answer engines can't easily surface a rating for this business.
No FAQPage markup found. FAQ schema is one of the more direct ways to get specific Q&A content picked up verbatim by answer engines.
No Product/Offer markup found. If specific products or menu items should be individually discoverable, this is missing.
